[Act: insolvency
 Chapter: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India
 Section: 191::Powers of Chairperson.
]


Save as otherwise determined by regulations, the Chairperson shall have powers of general superintendence and direction of the affairs of the Board and may also exercise such other powers as may be delegated to him by the Board.
